ios.desc:
Stacks is a calm, fully offline reader for the newsletters, blogs, and podcasts you already follow.

Add any Substack or RSS feed and Stacks downloads the full articles, images, and podcast episodes to your iPhone so you can read and listen anywhere, even with no signal. On a plane, on the subway, off the grid: nothing buffers, nothing reloads.

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• Truly offline — full article text, images, and audio are stored on your device for reading and listening with no connection.
• A clean, distraction-free reader with adjustable text size, light and dark themes, and a built-in podcast player.
• Smart automatic downloading keeps your latest posts ready and manages storage for you.
• Fast full-text search across everything you've saved.
• Collapsible comment threads, when you want them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Stacks has no servers of its own, no account, and no analytics. Everything it downloads stays on your device and goes nowhere else. No tracking, no ads.

No account is required: just add a feed and pull to refresh.

———
Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Substack Inc.

quotes.text:
I made this iOS app because I noticed that the native Substack app doesn't let you read offline effectively, and given that Substack is generally just text, this app would be straightforward to make.

I think it has two notable features, that being

1. the algorithm to make tradeoffs between storage, content length, and content quality by tracking a bunch of data

2. the app has no backend, tracking, ads, or anything else like that

Presumably you don't have any upcoming flights but if you do, please try it out, especially if you use the Substack app!
quotes.title: Show HN: Offline Substack Reader
